ValidationRule.description: Only allow direct update of actual completion date/time for item 27 and 28
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: NOT(CONTAINS($Profile.Name, "System Admin")) && NOT(CONTAINS($Profile.Name, "API")) && NOT(List_Order__c = 28) && NOT(List_Order__c = 29) && ( ISCHANGED(Actual_Completion_Time_Local__c) || ISCHANGED(Actual_Start_Time_Local__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Actual Start Time OR Actual Completion Time can only be modified for checklist item 28 and 29.
